summary.text: Caleb Brown is the Democratic candidate for North Carolina House of Representatives District 120, running against incumbent Republican Karl Gillespie in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A high school social studies teacher and coach, he has served in the U.S. Army National Guard since 2020, according to Ballotpedia.

paragraphs.text: Brown said in a Ballotpedia survey response that he is originally from South Carolina and has lived in Highlands, North Carolina, for seven years.
He graduated from Richland Northeast High School and earned a graduate degree from Winthrop University in 2016.

The survey response says he teaches high school social studies, coaches varsity soccer, has driven a school bus in rural North Carolina, and serves as a second lieutenant in the North Carolina Army National Guard.
Brown listed public education, opposition to using public tax dollars for private school vouchers, and access to affordable health care in rural North Carolina among his campaign priorities.
